title: The Azure Cistern-Keeper's Great Canon
summary: A great canon of the azure keeper that crowns the cistern with a great opening that absorbs the whole force of an incoming soul attack.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Tithe-Takers
summary: A treatise on taking a tithe from the strike and the striker together and returning the exact force drawn.

title: The Hawk-Eyed Reaper's High Art
summary: A high art of marking the richest hostile force from afar and diving to take it before it can be spent.

title: The Basin and River Absorbing Compendium
summary: A compendium on joining many streams of hostile force into one great flow and drinking it whole.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Reckoning of Draws
summary: A great reckoning of draws that ride the wind and turn a storm of blows into stored force and a gale in return.

title: The Canon of the Open Sky Well
summary: A canon of the well that stands open under the sky and fills from every technique that falls toward it.

title: Treatise of the Unbroken Draw
summary: A treatise on a draw that does not slacken through the longest exchange and ends in a maw that takes all force offered.

title: The Long Bearing Reclamation Compendium
summary: A compendium of draws laid on a true bearing that reclaim force from souls and techniques well beyond ordinary reach.
